rules.data_center_block: Headline names a data center AND a block word (moratorium, ban, halt, block, reject, pause, freeze, suspend, deny, stall, cancel, scrap, withdraw).
rules.power_price_policy: Headline names ratepayers or electricity/power/utility prices AND a policy word (bill, law, legislation, lawmakers, senate, house, congress, governor, signs, regulator, commission, tariff).
rules.ai_credit_stress: Headline names a rating agency, credit rating or credit spread AND a stress phrase (downgrade, negative outlook, spreads widen), AND the AI context test below.

searches.data_center_block: "data center" (moratorium OR ban OR blocked OR rejected OR paused OR halted) when:14d
searches.power_price_policy: (ratepayer OR "electricity prices" OR "power prices") (bill OR legislation OR law OR tariff OR regulators) when:14d
searches.ai_credit_stress: (Moody's OR Fitch OR "S&P Global Ratings" OR "credit rating" OR "credit spreads") (downgrade OR "negative outlook" OR widen OR widening) (AI OR "data center" OR hyperscaler) when:14d
